scope: Post hoc descriptive analysis of completed TRAIN and reused validation 60-second results only. Active 300-second and reserved test outcomes excluded.
checks: 16 effects reconstructed from all audited seed costs using Fraction
16 leave-one-geometry-out means independently recomputed using 45-digit Decimal arithmetic
Source summary geometry effects and primary means agree within 1e-10
No confidence intervals, p-values, retuning, denominator changes or gate changes
